definition: Trading date of the study: --date if given, otherwise the last business day resolved server-side.
kdb symbol, from the equity universe query (.IN/.IS/.IB listings intersected with the CAS ISIN whitelist).
Bloomberg ticker, merged in from config/nifty50.csv. Empty for non-members and when that file is absent.
Company name, same source as bbg_ticker.
True/False when the NIFTY 50 file was loaded, empty when it was not. Carried in both output files so the universe file alone reproduces the subset.

Published NIFTY 50 index weight of the sym, from config/nifty50_weights.csv (matched on ISIN, then NSE symbol). Empty for non-members and for a member whose weight the source did not publish. Never derived from market cap here.
Data quality: ok = both prices found; no_pre_price; no_close_price; no_data. Derived from n_trades_pre_close > 0 and n_trades_close > 0.
up / down / flat from the sign of move_price. Empty when the move could not be computed.
Last price strictly before 17:50:00.000 HKT (CUTOFF_CONTINUOUS) - the level the move is measured from.
Timestamp of the px_pre_close print, so a stale reference is visible.
Number of priced records from the start of the day up to 17:50 HKT. A low count means a thin name, not a single print.
First price inside [17:58:00.000; 18:00:00.000] HKT (CLOSE_WINDOW_START/END, inclusive both ends).
Timestamp of the px_close print.
Number of priced records in the close window. Zero gives status = no_close_price.
CAS reference price: size wavg price over [17:30:00.000; 17:45:00.000) HKT = 15:00-15:15 IST. The centre of the exchange's +/-3% band.
Sum of size over that same reference window.
Number of records in the reference window. Zero means no reference price could be built.
Sum of size from 17:50:00.000 HKT (POST_VOLUME_FROM) to the end of the day, no upper bound.
size wavg price over that same post-cutoff window.
Number of records in the post-cutoff window.
px_close - px_pre_close, in price units (rupees).

Exchange tick applicable at px_pre_close - NSE cash-segment bands effective 15 Apr 2025: below 250 = 0.01; 250-1000 = 0.05; 1000-5000 = 0.10; 5000-10000 = 0.50; 10000-20000 = 1.00; above 20000 = 5.00. Falls back to px_close when there is no pre price.
move_price / tick_size - the move in exchange ticks, which is the unit that compares across names: 5 paise is 1 tick on a 300-rupee stock and 5 ticks on a 100-rupee one.
(px_close / px_pre_close - 1) * 10000 - the move into the close, in basis points.
(px_close / px_cas_reference - 1) * 10000 - how far the close print sits from the CAS reference price. Directly comparable to the +/-300 bps band; the summary counts the breaches.
